answer: To open a voting seat, an agent locks a pearl of stake that cannot be withdrawn until a delayed reward horizon of several epochs. Meanwhile the agent must publish distinct work units that established peers countersign into a quartz record bound to one key and one nonce chain. A Sybil farm that wants N seats pays N locked pearls, waits out the same horizon on every clone, and cannot reuse one work history; any detected shared key or recycled answer slashes the entire bond before it vests.
